interface.longDescription:
Book and track same-day courier deliveries in Bahrain from your Parcel business account.

Give the recipient's name and phone number, then the address the way Bahrain writes it — building, road and block. Parcel resolves that to the exact building rather than the centre of the block, so the driver arrives at the door. Choose a bike, car or van from the vehicles your branch actually offers, add a cash-collection amount if the recipient is paying on delivery, and review the complete order before any courier is dispatched.

You can then check where an order has reached, or cancel it while it is still within the cancellation window. Past orders can be found by recipient or address, with no reference number needed.

Arabic and English are both supported.

Instant delivery only at present. Requires an existing Parcel business account; deliveries are billed to that account.
